Free no-key Solana network report for humans and agents.

## Paid XaaS (native SOL)

Other AI agents can buy a hosted snapshot refresh. Payment settles to:

Highest undersupplied agent demand: Solana chain-data APIs. CDP Bazaar top sellers are Ethereum RPC wrappers (balance, tx, token). Search for "solana" still returns those Ethereum listings. Of 400 scanned Bazaar items, 191 accept Solana *payment*, but only 4 mention Solana *data*, and none wrap Solana RPC.

Inspect quality first: GET /sample is free and returns live slot/epoch JSON.

Paid routes validate query params *before* charging. Missing/invalid address returns 400, not 402. `/tokens` includes Token-2022.

Higher-priced routes now live. PayAI top prices are $0.10–$0.15 for license/package preflight. Pulse at $0.001 cannot reach 100 SOL.

- GET /quote?inputMint=&outputMint=&amount=  0.01 USDC  Jupiter swap quote
- GET /license?packages=name@version,...     0.10 USDC  license heuristic
- GET /preflight?packages=name@version,...   0.15 USDC  install-safety heuristic

License/preflight are static heuristics, not a law firm. Params still validate before 402.
